latest_keyword_checks.name: latest_keyword_checks
latest_keyword_checks.definitionSql:
select distinct on (c.keyword_id)
  c.id as check_id,
  c.keyword_id,
  c.run_id,
  c.checked_at,
  c.status,
  c.answer_text,
  c.detected_domain,
  c.detected_text,
  c.detected_third_party,
  coalesce((c.raw->>'dry_run')::boolean, false) as is_demo
from checks c
order by c.keyword_id, c.checked_at desc
latest_keyword_checks.normalizedDefinition: select distinct on(c.keyword_id)c.id as check_id, c.keyword_id, c.run_id, c.checked_at, c.status, c.answer_text, c.detected_domain, c.detected_text, c.detected_third_party, coalesce((c.raw->>'dry_run')::boolean, false)as is_demo from checks c order by c.keyword_id, c.checked_at desc

latest_domain_citation_counts.name: latest_domain_citation_counts
latest_domain_citation_counts.definitionSql:
select
  cs.domain,
  bool_or(cs.is_own) as is_own,
  bool_or(cs.is_competitor) as is_competitor,
  count(distinct lkc.keyword_id)::int as keyword_count
from latest_keyword_checks lkc
join check_sources cs on cs.check_id = lkc.check_id
group by cs.domain
order by keyword_count desc, cs.domain asc
latest_domain_citation_counts.normalizedDefinition: select cs.domain, bool_or(cs.is_own)as is_own, bool_or(cs.is_competitor)as is_competitor, count(distinct lkc.keyword_id)::int as keyword_count from latest_keyword_checks lkc join check_sources cs on cs.check_id = lkc.check_id group by cs.domain order by keyword_count desc, cs.domain asc
